review.notes: Full normalized word-level diff of the OCR against the extracted text of all 33 physical pages (born-digital arXiv PDF, reliable text layer, no U+200B damage); 300 dpi renders used to verify the flagged name on physical p.4 and figure regions. All 130 reference entries are present, all five tables match the source numerically (Table 1: 5, Table 2: 29, Table 3: 73, Table 4: 9, Table 5: 34 decimal numbers, zero diffs), and no code fences, spurious headings or dropped footnote bodies exist. The document has no page-bottom footnotes; superscripts in the title block are author affiliations and the Table 1 dagger note is present in the OCR caption. Remaining diff opcodes are running headers, figure images with in-figure axis/legend text, and LaTeX equations, none of which are defects. The source itself prints a stray comma in 'Chen et al., 2025,;' on physical p.4 which the OCR renders as 'Chen et al., 2025;'; left unchanged as the OCR's global citation-punctuation normalization, not a transcription garble.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.4 (section 3.2, DreamDojo-HV Dataset) prints '(Bi et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025,; Kareer et al., 2025; Li et al., ...' with a capital K; the PDF text layer agrees ('Kareer et al.'). OCR misread the K as a C, producing the non-word 'Career et al.'
